tcs.title: Transaction Coordination Specialist
tcs.tagline: Calm. Detail-obsessed. The first text you get when something needs your eyes.
tcs.fitLine: Pick Eileen if you want a coordinator who explains every detail and never lets a deadline slip.
tcs.pullQuote: I treat every file like it's my own family closing.

tcs.title: Head of Transaction Execution
tcs.tagline: The closer. The one who cleans up messy files before they break.
tcs.fitLine: Pick Mile if your file is complicated and you want the standard-bearer running point.
tcs.pullQuote: If something's slipping, I catch it before close. That's the job.

tcs.title: Transaction Coordination Specialist
tcs.tagline: Florida-trained. Deadline-driven. The depth behind every file.
tcs.fitLine: Pick Silvia if you want depth and cross-coverage on every deal.
tcs.pullQuote: Coordination is anticipation. By the time something is due, it's already done.

tcs.title: Founder & Broker-Owner
tcs.tagline: Founder. Licensed Florida broker. Reserved for Broker Compliance Review files.
tcs.fitLine: Marlenyi handles Broker Compliance Review files only. Not routine TC.
tcs.pullQuote: Aari exists because deals fall apart in the middle. We built the version we wanted to hire.
